title: Searching Git History by Meaning
author: Sudipta Sarkar
summary: How a retrieval pipeline can answer questions about changes across commits.
content:
A commit hash is a good address, but it is hard to remember when you want to find the change that introduced a feature. A useful search record pairs each commit message with its hash and the files it changed.

In GitRAG, semantic search retrieves relevant commits before a language model explains the changes. Keeping the hashes in the answer gives the reader a direct way to inspect the original evidence.

title: Modeling Customer Addresses in Spring
author: Sudipta Sarkar
summary: A small data-modeling example for a customer with multiple addresses.
content:
A customer can have a home address and a mailing address. Keeping addresses in their own table lets each row describe one location and reference the customer who owns it.

In a Spring application, that relationship can be represented by an address entity with a many-to-one customer field. A service can then update one address while preserving the customer's other locations.
